permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks only to your own TapBack server: unread counts for the chats you picked, and the replies you send.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Listens only while you hold to talk, to dictate a reply. The audio goes only to your own TapBack server for transcription.

permissions.name: phone-microphone
permissions.desc: Used for dictating a reply only when the glasses microphone is not available. The audio goes only to your own TapBack server.
